items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 2:1
items.html: (To the question) Through the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, which was in Tzimtzum Bet [Restriction Two], meaning that Malchut rose to Hochma, Malchut mixed and joined with every Sefira up to Hochma. (p. 485, entry "Malchut")
